description: Na₉Fe₂O₇ crystallizes in the orthorhombic Pca2₁ space group. There are nine inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to five O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.33-2.76 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to three O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.31-2.38 Å. In the third Na site, Na is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to four O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.28-2.66 Å. In the fourth Na site, Na is bonded to six O atoms to form NaO₆ octahedra that share  a cornercorner with one NaO₄ tetrahedra, corners with three equivalent FeO₄ tetrahedra, and  an edgeedge with one NaO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.42-2.64 Å. In the fifth Na site, Na is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to five O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.33-2.92 Å. In the sixth Na site, Na is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to five O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.39-2.89 Å. In the seventh Na site, Na is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to five O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.32-2.63 Å. In the eighth Na site, Na is bonded to four O atoms to form distorted NaO₄ tetrahedra that share  a cornercorner with one NaO₆ octahedra,  a cornercorner with one FeO₄ tetrahedra,  an edgeedge with one NaO₆ octahedra, and  an edgeedge with one FeO₄ tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 38°. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.35-2.44 Å. In the ninth Na site, Na is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to five O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.33-2.78 Å. There are two inequivalent Fe sites. In the first Fe site, Fe is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to three O atoms. There is one shorter (1.84 Å) and two longer (1.87 Å) Fe-O bond lengths. In the second Fe site, Fe is bonded to four O atoms to form FeO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with three equivalent NaO₆ octahedra,  a cornercorner with one NaO₄ tetrahedra, and  an edgeedge with one NaO₄ tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 40-53°. There are a spread of Fe-O bond distances ranging from 1.91-1.95 Å. There are seven inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 7-coordinate geometry to six Na and one Fe atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 7-coordinate geometry to six Na and one Fe atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a 7-coordinate geometry to six Na and one Fe atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a 8-coordinate geometry to seven Na and one Fe atom. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a 7-coordinate geometry to six Na and one Fe atom. In the sixth O site, O is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to five Na and one Fe atom. In the seventh O site, O is bonded in a 7-coordinate geometry to six Na and one Fe atom.
